tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_drow_ranger_frost_a: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage.  Slow lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
Ice-encased arrows pierce the silence, chilling their victims to the core.
The slow duration is refreshed on successive casts.

Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.

Traxex wasn't just adopted by the Drow, she was adopted by the lands they lived in.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger_bio:
Drow Ranger's given name is Traxex--a name well suited to the short, trollish, rather repulsive Drow people. But Traxex herself is not a Drow. Her parents were travelers in a caravan set upon by bandits, whose noisy slaughter of innocents roused the ire of the quiet Drow people.

After the battle settled, the Drow discovered a small girl-child hiding in the ruined wagons, and agreed she could not be abandoned. Even as child, Traxex showed herself naturally adept at the arts they prized: Stealth, silence, subtlety. In spirit, if not in physique, she might have been a Drow changeling, returned to her proper home. But as she grew, she towered above her family and came to think of herself as ugly. After all, her features were smooth and symmetrical, entirely devoid of warts and coarse whiskers.

Estranged from her adopted tribe, she withdrew to live alone in the woods. Lost travelers who find their way from the forest sometimes speak of an impossibly beautiful Ranger who peered at them from deep among the trees, then vanished like a dream before they could approach. Lithe and stealthy, icy hot, she moves like mist in silence. That whispering you hear is her frozen arrows finding an enemy's heart.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger_hype: Not many can escape Drow Ranger once she's within range. After her foes have been silenced with a chilling blast, she finishes them off with a barrage of slowing, ice-tipped arrows that few can survive.

qualifications.raw: [[Roshan]] is innately immune to all forced movement sources.

* The ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** Considers enemy {{M|illusions}} and {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
*** The following enemy heroes also disables the {{M|aura}}:
**** {{M|Hidden}} heroes.
**** {{M|Invulnerable}} heroes.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]]
*** The proc chance is determined during Drow's {{M|attack point}}, and uses {{M|pseudo-random distribution}} {{Proc|{{#var:Marksmanship value2}}|tal={{#var:Marksmanship value2 tal}}|lvl=3}}
*** {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Conditional}}
**** Marksmanship is a bonus [[conditional attack damage]] source and has the following properties:
***** Has {{M|True Strike}}.
***** The bonus attack damage values are directly added to Drow's attack damage in the {{M|combat log}} and not displayed on the [[HUD]].
**** Does not interact with the following sources:
***** Percentage-based {{M|bonus attack damage|x}} sources.
****** {{M|Critical strike}} sources.
***** {{M|Main armor}} sources.
**** Interacts with the following sources:
***** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
****** {{M|Lifesteal}} sources.
****** {{M|Cleave}} sources.
***** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
****** {{M|Damage block}} sources.
*** Does not proc on the following units:
**** {{M|Allied units|x}}.
**** {{M|Buildings}}.

fields.value:

** Grants {{M|agility}} bonus to units that fulfill the following conditions:
*** {{M|Ranged}} unit.

*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|[[Agility|Agi]]Bonus {{=}} CurrentAgi × ({{#var:Precision Aura value1}} + {{#var:Precision Aura basic1}} × SelfLvl)}}
*** The bonus values adapts immediately, and is provided by an {{M|aura}} that checks for nearby heroes in 0.1-second intervals.
** Affects the following units:
*** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
** Does not affect the following units:
*** {{M|Hidden}} units.

fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Attack Modifier}}
** Frost Arrows are an active attack modifier, and have the following properties:
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|[[Cast Range|CastRange]] {{=}} Hero[[Attack Range|AtkRange]]}}
*** Not affected by {{M|cast range|x}} sources.
*** Affected by {{M|attack range}} sources of the same range-type as the caster.
** Both {{M|Autocast}} and an active cast uses Drow's current {{M|attack range}}.
*** Has Autocast off by default.
** All ability effects do not affect the following units:
*** {{M|Allied units|x}}.
*** {{M|Buildings}}
*** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
** {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Instant}}
*** This ability component can be applied by other [[instant attack]] sources.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# {{cf|aghnotes}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|drow_ranger_frost_arrows_hypothermia}}
*#* {{Symbol|Modifier|Stack}}
*#** All reduction values of this source stack additively per applied stack, and multiplicatively with other [[restoration manipulation]] sources.
*#** Applies 1 debuff stack on the enemy unit per successful attack, including from the following attack sources:
*#*** {{A|Drow Ranger|Multishot|text=Multishot Projectiles}}.
*#*** {{M|Instant attack}} sources.
*#* The {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} immediately updates all current {{A|Drow Ranger|Frost Arrows}} and {{A|Drow Ranger|Multishot|text=Multishot Projectiles}}.
*#** Reapplying the debuff increases the number of stacks and debuff values.
*# {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Conditional}} {{Code|drow_ranger_frost_arrows_slow}}
*#* Applies the {{M|movement speed}} slow.
*#** Reapplying the debuff refreshes the duration.
*#* Frost Arrows are a bonus [[conditional attack damage]] source and have the following properties:
*#** The bonus attack damage values are directly added to Drow's attack damage in the {{M|combat log}} and not displayed on the [[HUD]].
*#** Does not interact with the following sources:
*#*** Percentage-based {{M|bonus attack damage|x}} sources.
*#**** {{M|Critical strike}} sources.
*#** Interacts with the following sources:
*#*** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}

*#**** {{M|Cleave}} sources.
*#*** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}

<hr>

*** {{M|Invisible}} units.
*** {{M|Untargetable}} units.

**# {{Symbol|Damage|Magical}} {{Symbol|Spell Damage}}

**#* {{cf|expr}} {{Code|SplDmg {{=}} n × Stacks}}
**# The {{M|movement speed}} slow.
**#* Reapplying the debuff refreshes the duration.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: Traxex is rather fond of the tranquility of physical combat, calling on her Drow heritage to end the incantations of opposing magi.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value: Releases a wave that applies True Sight, silences, and knocks enemy units back relative to how close they are to the Drow.

fields.value: [[Roshan]] is innately immune to all forced movement sources.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: Grants self bonus movement speed upon cast while repulsing assailants who venture too close.

mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Target|Point}}
** Can affect enemy units up to {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{#expr:{{#var:Gust value1}}+{{#var:Gust value2}}}}-distance away with the travel distance and effect radius.
** [[File:Dota2 Drow Ranger Gust Visualization icon-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Drow Ranger Gust Visualization icon-2.png|84px]]
*** The ability's starts at Drow' current position [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}}, with the first radius extending to point [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] .
**** The total ability [[area-of-effect]] is [[Wikipedia:cylinder|cylinder]]-shaped.
**** {{Code|OP {{=}} {{#expr:{{#var:Gust value2}}/2}}}}
**** {{Code|PQ {{=}} {{#var:Gust value1}}}}
*** Circle [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|21px|Q]] is the end radius.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** The debuff applied has two main components:
*** Reapplying the debuff refreshes its duration.
*** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|drowranger_wave_of_silence_[[knockback]]}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Knockback|Front}}
**** Applies a non-disabling {{M|knockback}} on affected enemy units within the area-of-effect upon cast.
**** Knocks all affected units to a fixed {{#var:Gust value4}}-distance behind from point [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|O|21px]] , over {{#var:Gust value6}} seconds.
***** Hence the min and max knockback speed are {{#expr:{{#var:Gust value3}}/{{#var:Gust value5}}}} ‒ {{calc|{{#var:Gust value4}}/v1 round2|v1={{#var:Gust value6}}}} correspondingly to the distance between Drow and the affected units.
****** The knockback duration varies depending on the terrain.
****** Can push enemy units over {{M|impassable terrain}}.
***** Affected units will always be {{Code|{{#var:Gust value4}}-distance}} away from Drow at the end of the knockback duration.
**** {{Symbol|Trees}}
***** [[Trees]] within 200-radius that the affected enemy come in contact with are destroyed.
*** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|drowranger_wave_of_silence}}
**** Applies the following ability effects on affected enemy units:
***** {{M|Silence}}
***** Grants {{M|True Sight}} over affected units.
**** Affects the following units:
***** {{M|Fogged units}}.
***** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
**** Does not affect the following units:
***** {{M|Hidden}} units.
***** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** {{Symbol|bonus t3r}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|drowranger_wave_of_silence_buff}}
*** Applies the buff on self, with a {{Code|0%}} {{M|movement speed}} bonus, even before the {{ValueColor||movement speed granting|20tal}} is learned.
*** Reapplying the buff refreshes the duration.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: Traxex wasn't just adopted by the Drow, she was adopted by the lands they lived in.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Creates a hill of ice beneath Drow, knocking away nearby enemy units. Grants all units on the hill flying vision.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: Explicitly grants ranged heroes, of both factions, bonus attack range at the top of the Glacier.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: The brittle solids beneath Drow knocks all enemy units aside as it emerges.

fields.name: desc3
fields.value:
Both the phase movement and the unobstructed movement granted by the Glacier aura has a linger duration, only for the Drow.

The Drow conditionally deals bonus total attack damage when attacking targets below the Glacier from high ground.

fields.name: desc4
fields.value: Does not interrupt Multishot upon cast.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Acquiring {{M|Aghanim's Shard}} unlocks this ability in the {{Spellslot|4|5}}.

* Applies the following ability effects to units within the shard spawn radius:
** Can knock units over {{M|impassable terrain}}.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** {{M|Upward movement|text=Moves}} Drow ≈125-distance upward.
*** Does not interrupt {{A|Drow Ranger|Multishot}}'s {{M|channeling}} upon cast.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** A non-disabling {{M|knockback}} with a 75-height arc.
*** Although units affected by the following sources are not blocked, they can be knocked back aside or inside by the Glacier shards. 
**** {{M|Flying movement}} sources.
**** {{M|Unobstructed movement}} sources.
*** {{Symbol|Trees}}
**** [[Trees]] within 100-radius of the knocked enemy unit are destroyed upon contact.

* Creates an {{M|aura}} upon cast that grants the following ability effects to units on the Glacier:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]] {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** {{M|Phase movement}}.
*** {{M|Unobstructed movement}}.
**** Affects the following ability components:
***** {{A|Drow Ranger|Frost Arrows}}
****** Does not increase the cast range of this ability.
***** {{A|Drow Ranger|Multishot}}
****** Increases the bonus arrow travel distance.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]] {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** Affects both allied units and enemy units:
**** Bonus {{M|attack range}} of the unit's attack range type.
*** {{Symbol|Vision|Flying}}
**** [[Flying vision]] corresponding to the affected unit's {{M|daytime}} and {{M|nighttime}} vision respectively.
*** Has a {{#expr:{{G|uphill miss chance}}*100}}% [[Evasion#Uphill Miss Chance|uphill miss chance]] while attacking units on top of the Glacier.
*** Does not affect the following units:
**** {{M|Hidden}} units.
**** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
**** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|21px|3]] {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Vision|Base}}
*** [[Vision#Vision Blockers|Artificially blocks]] the enemy's [[vision]] akin to obstructed vision by higher elevations.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-4.png|21px|4]]
*** Checks for both Drow's and the attacked unit's terrain levels upon Drow's {{M|attack point}}.
*** {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Conditional}}
**** Glacier is a bonus [[conditional attack damage]] source and has the following properties:
***** The bonus total attack damage values are directly added to Drow's attack damage in the {{M|combat log}} and not displayed on the [[HUD]].
****** Considers both the {{M|Main Attack Damage|text=main}} and {{M|Bonus Attack Damage|text=bonus}} attack damage.
****** Stacks additively with other total attack damage manipulation sources.
**** Interacts with the following sources:
***** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
****** {{M|Lifesteal}} sources.
****** {{M|Critical strike}} sources.
****** {{M|Cleave}} sources.
****** The following sources applied on self do not affect the bonus conditional attack damage component:
******* {{M|Upward movement}} sources.
******* {{M|Flying movement}} sources.
***** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
****** {{M|Damage block}} sources.

* Recasting the ability creates another independent glacier.
** {{Symbol|Target|Area-Inter}}
*** Multiple overlapping Glacier {{M|aura}} radius do not stack.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger
data.bio_loc:
Drow Ranger's given name is Traxex--a name well suited to the short, trollish, rather repulsive Drow people. But Traxex herself is not a Drow. Her parents were travelers in a caravan set upon by bandits, whose noisy slaughter of innocents roused the ire of the quiet Drow people.

After the battle settled, the Drow discovered a small girl-child hiding in the ruined wagons, and agreed she could not be abandoned. Even as child, Traxex showed herself naturally adept at the arts they prized: Stealth, silence, subtlety. In spirit, if not in physique, she might have been a Drow changeling, returned to her proper home. But as she grew, she towered above her family and came to think of herself as ugly. After all, her features were smooth and symmetrical, entirely devoid of warts and coarse whiskers.

Estranged from her adopted tribe, she withdrew to live alone in the woods. Lost travelers who find their way from the forest sometimes speak of an impossibly beautiful Ranger who peered at them from deep among the trees, then vanished like a dream before they could approach. Lithe and stealthy, icy hot, she moves like mist in silence. That whispering you hear is her frozen arrows finding an enemy's heart.
data.hype_loc: Not many can escape Drow Ranger once she's within range. After her foes have been silenced with a chilling blast, she finishes them off with a barrage of slowing, ice-tipped arrows that few can survive.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_frost_arrows
abilities.desc_loc: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage.  Slow lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Ice-encased arrows pierce the silence, chilling their victims to the core.
notes_loc: The slow duration is refreshed on successive casts.
abilities.scepter_loc: Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_wave_of_silence
abilities.desc_loc: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.
abilities.lore_loc: Traxex is rather fond of the tranquility of physical combat, calling on her Drow heritage to end the incantations of opposing magi.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_multishot
abilities.desc_loc:
CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + %arrow_range_base%. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds.

Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.
abilities.lore_loc: In the ranger's youth, learning to fire multiple arrows at once was considered a distracting frivolity. In the war of the Ancients, such technique has become strange necessity.
notes_loc: Arrow base damage pierces magic immunity.
Frost Arrows' damage and slow do not pierce magic immunity.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_glacier
abilities.desc_loc:
Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.
abilities.lore_loc: Traxex wasn't just adopted by the Drow, she was adopted by the lands they lived in.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_trueshot
abilities.desc_loc: Grants Drow bonus agility based on Drow's current agility and level. Nearby ranged heroes received %trueshot_agi_bonus_allies_pct%%% of the bonus agility.
abilities.lore_loc: Traxex' time spent alone in the forests of her Drow home has allowed her to teach other archers how to improve their bow skills.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_marksmanship
abilities.desc_loc: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within %disable_range% range.
abilities.lore_loc: The Drow Ranger is the epitome of archery prowess.
